activity_b.text: Good morning, Kavin. Nice to meet you.
Please relax and take a seat.
How are you feeling today?
Good morning, sir. How are you today?
Quite good. I’m looking forward to talking to you about my career.
Let’s start with something simple then.
Tell me, what do you know about our company?
Last night I read about your company on the Internet.
I saw that you upgraded a network system in Vavuniya and that you focus strongly on security and performance.
I also liked the way you use modern monitoring tools.
I’m glad you checked it.
Now, before we talk about your skills, tell me—what do you like most in the ICT field?
Honestly, sir, I like solving technical problems.
When we configure a router, check a server, or fix a software issue, I can see the results immediately.
I also enjoy working with a team.
That’s a good attitude.
And what tasks are you good at?
I am good at installing basic software and organising digital files.
During my training, I set up user accounts, checked network cables, and helped the instructor update antivirus systems.
And what technical skills do you have?
I know how to read simple network diagrams, monitor system performance, and use tools like network testers, task managers, and troubleshooting utilities.
Last month, I resolved a slow-login problem in the lab.
We sometimes use cloud-based dashboards for remote management.
Are you familiar with them?
I am not familiar with them, sir, but I can read about them on the Internet.
That’s how I learned more about basic cybersecurity.
Excellent.
Finally, why should we select you?
Because I learn fast, I work diligently, and I’m always ready to support the team.
Well said, Kavin. We’ll contact you soon.
